correctness.rationale: An exhaustive enumeration gives 160 nonempty simplices with f=(14,56,70,20). An explicit 74-pair face matching passes complete acyclicity on 402 Hasse incidences, yielding one critical vertex, nine critical 2-cells, and two critical 3-cells. Signed integral elimination gives zero for both 3-cell attaching degrees into 9 two-spheres; hence the exact integral homotopy wedge follows. Independent mod-2 boundary ranks (13,43,18) and exact rational H3 kernel and reflection chain traces confirm numerical modules.

value.rationale: The exact object is the natural cone on a four-vertex path with directed two-cycles: the simplest five-vertex path cone outside acyclic matching reductions, and a one-rim-edge-open counterpart of the bidirected wheel. Its first simply connected mixed-dimensional sphere wedge with distinct ranks 9 and 2 and a nontrivial rational reflection decomposition provides an explicit motivated boundary case, not a parameter substitution or a face-count-only check. The scope is finite and no broad conjecture is asserted.
